updateCheckHelp: Once a day at most, Haunt asks GitHub for its latest release. Nothing else is sent.
noLogs: While Haunt is worked on, the scanner writes to the console instead.
nothingToClear: There were no kept call graphs
clearedHelp: Each repository works its call graph out again on its next scan.
clearHelp: Call graphs are kept so repositories open at once. Clearing frees space; they are worked out again on the next scan.
